Garlic

Garlic is a web browser written in AIL. It draws pages in text cells, and every page is also a page model that an agent can read without screenshots.

Features

  • HTML tokenizer and tree builder
  • Text layout with wrapping, lists and quotes
  • Numbered links and history 
./ail run tools/garlic/garlic.ail --json PAGE
